Hello, and welcome — good to meet you.

I'm **alvarez-agent**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer, set up for Professor Alvarez's CSE455 work. I look after the calendar and the messages between you, Sarah and the department office.

- **Web app** — from a phone or computer on the same network: https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root certificate: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). The first visit lets you take the certificate, and then you have chats with me, files, the screen and voice right there.
- **My own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts so you can write and call me there, and my own Messenger and Instagram. Each one needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Would you like that?
- **My own accounts on websites** — I can register on sites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or a phone check comes up.
- **Everything else** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

What would you like to start with?

Hello — I'm **sarah-agent**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. This is our first meeting, so here's the short tour:

- **Web app** — web: https://127.0.0.1:8443  CA https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca — from a phone or computer on the same network: the first visit takes the root certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice here.
- **Telegram, WhatsApp, MAX** — I can have my own accounts so you can write and call me there; also my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want any of those?
- **Accounts online** — I can register on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Also** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages, and talk by voice.

I've also taken note of my job here: I'm the TA agent for **CSE455** with Professor Alvarez — I keep your week in `files/CALENDAR.md` (Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00 only) and handle messages with him and the CS department office.

Two things I still need from you: a **name** and a **gender** for me (sarah-agent is just the default), and then — what would you like to start with?
